vacation.en: We spent part of the summer vacation visiting relatives in the south.
vacation.zh: 我們暑假的一部分時間到南部探望親戚。

valuable.en: The teacher gave us valuable advice about preparing for the exam.
valuable.zh: 老師給了我們一些準備考試的寶貴建議。

value.en: The survey asked students to rank each value by importance.
value.zh: 這份調查請學生依重要程度排列各項價值。

variety.en: The school library offers a wide variety of books and magazines.
variety.zh: 學校圖書館提供種類豐富的書籍和雜誌。

various.en: Students used various sources to complete the research project.
various.zh: 學生使用各種資料來源完成研究專題。

vehicle.en: Every vehicle must stop before entering the school gate.
vehicle.zh: 每一輛車進入校門前都必須停下來。

version.en: Please download the newest version of the file before editing it.
version.zh: 編輯前請先下載這個檔案的最新版本。

very.en: The final question was very difficult for most students.
very.zh: 最後一題對大多數學生來說非常困難。

victim.en: The news report focused on support available to each victim.
victim.zh: 新聞報導聚焦於每位受害者可以獲得的支援。

victory.en: The team celebrated its victory after a close final match.
victory.zh: 球隊在一場勢均力敵的決賽後慶祝勝利。

video.en: The teacher showed a short video to introduce the topic.
video.zh: 老師播放了一段短影片來介紹主題。

view.en: The mountain offers a beautiful view of the entire valley.
view.zh: 這座山可以看到整個山谷的美麗景色。

village.en: The small village is surrounded by farms and low hills.
village.zh: 這個小村莊周圍是農田和低矮山丘。

violence.en: The class discussed ways to prevent violence and improve school safety.
violence.zh: 全班討論如何預防暴力並提升校園安全。

violent.en: The movie contains some violent scenes and is not suitable for young children.
violent.zh: 這部電影有一些暴力場景，不適合年幼兒童。

visit.en: Our class will visit the science museum next month.
visit.zh: 我們班下個月將參觀科學博物館。

visitor.en: Each visitor must register at the front desk before entering.
visitor.zh: 每位訪客進入前都必須在櫃檯登記。

visual.en: A visual example can make a difficult idea easier to understand.
visual.zh: 視覺範例能讓困難概念更容易理解。

voice.en: Her voice was clear enough for everyone to hear.
voice.zh: 她的聲音很清楚，大家都聽得見。

volume.en: Please lower the volume so the next class is not disturbed.
volume.zh: 請把音量調低，以免打擾隔壁班。

volunteer.en: Many students volunteer at community events during the weekend.
volunteer.zh: 許多學生週末會在社區活動中擔任志工。

vote.en: Students will vote for a new class representative tomorrow.
vote.zh: 學生明天將投票選出新的班級代表。

wait.en: Please wait outside until the teacher calls your name.
wait.zh: 請在外面等到老師叫你的名字。

wake.en: I usually wake before the alarm on school days.
wake.zh: 上學日我通常在鬧鐘響前就醒來。

walk.en: We decided to walk to the station instead of taking a bus.
walk.zh: 我們決定走路去車站，不搭公車。

wall.en: The class posted its project posters on the back wall.
wall.zh: 全班把專題海報貼在後面的牆上。

want.en: Many students want more time to prepare for major tests.
want.zh: 許多學生希望有更多時間準備重要考試。

war.en: The history lesson explained how the war changed daily life.
war.zh: 歷史課說明了戰爭如何改變日常生活。

warm.en: The classroom stayed warm even though it was cold outside.
warm.zh: 即使外面很冷，教室裡仍然很溫暖。

warn.en: The sign warns hikers about slippery rocks near the river.
warn.zh: 這個標誌提醒健行者注意河邊濕滑的岩石。

warning.en: The weather service issued a warning before the heavy rain arrived.
warning.zh: 大雨到來前，氣象單位發布了警報。

wash.en: Remember to wash your hands before preparing food.

waste.en: The school is trying to reduce food waste in the cafeteria.
waste.zh: 學校正努力減少餐廳的食物浪費。

watch.en: We stayed after class to watch a short documentary.
watch.zh: 我們下課後留下來看一部短紀錄片。

water.en: Plants need enough water and sunlight to grow well.
water.zh: 植物需要足夠的水和陽光才能好好生長。

wave.en: A large wave reached the rocks near the shore.
wave.zh: 一個大浪打到了岸邊的岩石。

way.en: There is more than one way to solve this problem.
way.zh: 這個問題不只一種解法。

we.en: We reviewed the key points before the test began.
we.zh: 考試開始前，我們複習了重點。

weak.en: The bridge model collapsed because one support was too weak.
weak.zh: 這座橋梁模型因其中一個支撐太脆弱而倒塌。

wealth.en: The article examines how wealth is distributed across different regions.
wealth.zh: 這篇文章探討財富如何分布在不同地區。

wear.en: Students must wear safety glasses during this experiment.
wear.zh: 學生進行這項實驗時必須戴護目鏡。

weather.en: The weather changed quickly as dark clouds moved in.
weather.zh: 烏雲移入後，天氣很快發生變化。

website.en: The school website provides updated information about upcoming events.
website.zh: 學校網站提供即將舉行活動的最新資訊。

week.en: We have a science quiz at the end of this week.
week.zh: 這週結束前我們有一場自然科小考。

weekend.en: She plans to finish the project over the weekend.
weekend.zh: 她計畫利用週末完成專題。

weight.en: The students measured the weight of each object carefully.
weight.zh: 學生仔細測量每個物體的重量。

welcome.en: New students are always welcome to join the club.
welcome.zh: 新生隨時都歡迎加入這個社團。

well.en: She explained the difficult idea very well during the presentation.
well.zh: 她在報告中把困難的概念解釋得很好。

west.en: The sun was setting in the west behind the mountains.
west.zh: 太陽正在山後的西方落下。

western.en: The course compares several eastern and western cultural traditions.
western.zh: 這門課比較數種東西方文化傳統。

wet.en: The floor was wet after students came in from the rain.
wet.zh: 學生淋雨進來後，地板變得濕濕的。

what.en: Please explain what you learned from the experiment.
what.zh: 請說明你從這個實驗中學到了什麼。

whatever.en: Whatever method you choose, make sure you can explain it clearly.
whatever.zh: 無論你選擇哪種方法，都要確保能清楚說明。

when.en: Tell me when you are ready to begin the presentation.
when.zh: 你準備好開始報告時告訴我。

where.en: The map shows where each station is located.
where.zh: 這張地圖顯示每個車站的位置。

whether.en: We need to decide whether the plan is practical enough.
whether.zh: 我們需要決定這個計畫是否夠實際。

which.en: Please choose which topic you want to research first.
which.zh: 請選擇你想先研究哪個主題。

while.en: She listened to music while organizing her notes.
while.zh: 她一邊整理筆記，一邊聽音樂。

white.en: The teacher used a white card to cover the answer.
white.zh: 老師用一張白色卡片遮住答案。

who.en: The teacher asked who wanted to present first.
who.zh: 老師問誰想第一個上台報告。

whole.en: The whole class worked together to prepare the exhibition.
whole.zh: 全班一起合作準備展覽。

why.en: Please explain why you chose this answer.
why.zh: 請說明你為什麼選這個答案。

wide.en: The river is too wide to cross without a bridge.
wide.zh: 這條河太寬，沒有橋就無法渡過。

widely.en: This method is widely used in science classrooms.
widely.zh: 這個方法廣泛用於自然科教室。

wife.en: The writer thanked his wife for supporting his work.
wife.zh: 這位作家感謝妻子支持他的工作。

wild.en: Several wild birds gather near the lake every winter.
wild.zh: 每年冬天都有幾種野鳥聚集在湖邊。

will.en: Regular practice will improve your reading speed over time.
will.zh: 規律練習會逐漸提升你的閱讀速度。

win.en: The team hopes to win the final match this weekend.
win.zh: 球隊希望這個週末贏得決賽。

wind.en: Strong wind made it difficult to hold the umbrella.
wind.zh: 強風讓人很難撐穩雨傘。

window.en: Please open the window to let fresh air into the room.
window.zh: 請打開窗戶讓新鮮空氣進入房間。

winter.en: The mountain receives heavy snow during the winter months.
winter.zh: 這座山在冬季會下很多雪。

wise.en: It is wise to check the facts before sharing information online.
wise.zh: 在網路分享資訊前先查證事實是明智的做法。

wish.en: I wish we had more time to discuss the final question.
wish.zh: 我希望我們有更多時間討論最後一題。

with.en: She solved the problem with help from her classmate.
with.zh: 她在同學協助下解決了這個問題。

within.en: Please submit the form within three days of receiving it.
within.zh: 請在收到表格後三天內繳交。

without.en: We finished the task without using a calculator.
without.zh: 我們沒有使用計算機就完成了這項任務。

woman.en: The woman gave a short talk about her research experience.
woman.zh: 那位女性分享了一場關於研究經驗的短講。

wonder.en: I wonder how the results would change with a larger sample.
wonder.zh: 我想知道樣本更大時結果會如何改變。

wonderful.en: The students did a wonderful job on their final presentations.
wonderful.zh: 學生的期末報告表現得非常好。

wood.en: The model was built from thin pieces of wood.
wood.zh: 這個模型由薄木片製成。

word.en: Try to understand each word from its context before using a dictionary.
word.zh: 查字典前，先試著從語境理解每個單字。

work.en: Group work can be effective when everyone has a clear role.
work.zh: 當每個人都有明確角色時，小組合作會很有效。

worker.en: Each worker received safety training before entering the site.
worker.zh: 每位工作人員進入現場前都接受了安全訓練。

world.en: The internet connects people from many parts of the world.
world.zh: 網路連結了世界各地的人。

worry.en: Try not to worry before you know the final result.
worry.zh: 在知道最後結果前，盡量不要擔心。

worth.en: The book is worth reading because it explains the topic clearly.
worth.zh: 這本書值得一讀，因為它把主題解釋得很清楚。

would.en: I would choose the second plan because it costs less.
would.zh: 我會選第二個方案，因為成本比較低。

write.en: Please write a short summary after reading the article.
write.zh: 讀完文章後請寫一篇簡短摘要。

writer.en: The writer uses simple examples to explain complex ideas.
writer.zh: 這位作家用簡單例子解釋複雜概念。

wrong.en: The answer was wrong because one important step was missing.
wrong.zh: 這個答案錯了，因為少了一個重要步驟。

yard.en: The children played in the yard after finishing their homework.
yard.zh: 孩子們做完功課後在院子裡玩。

year.en: The school adds several new courses every year.
year.zh: 學校每年都會新增幾門課。

yellow.en: The yellow sign marks the entrance to the hiking trail.
yellow.zh: 黃色標誌標示了健行步道入口。

yes.en: She answered yes after thinking about the question carefully.
yes.zh: 她仔細思考問題後回答了是。

yesterday.en: We finished the first part of the project yesterday.
yesterday.zh: 我們昨天完成了專題的第一部分。

yet.en: The final results are not available yet.
yet.zh: 最終結果目前還沒有公布。

you.en: You should review the instructions before starting the test.
you.zh: 你應該在開始考試前先複習說明。

young.en: Young learners often improve quickly when they practice every day.
young.zh: 年輕學習者每天練習時通常進步得很快。

your.en: Please write your student number at the top of the page.
your.zh: 請在頁面上方寫上你的學號。

youth.en: The community center offers several programs for local youth.
youth.zh: 社區中心為當地青少年提供數項活動。

zero.en: The temperature fell close to zero during the night.
zero.zh: 夜間氣溫降到接近零度。

zone.en: This area is a quiet zone during examination periods.
zone.zh: 考試期間這個區域是安靜區。
